title: Prenuvo memberships
description: A light section with an arced top and a cool grey-blue fog fading to white. A big centred headline and lead, then three dark plan cards in a row (stacked on phones): title, a small uppercase spec line, a hairline, a short description, a gradient pill, and a blurred light beam (lilac, blue, green) slanting up from the bottom-right corner. A centred pill closes it. The cards rise 80px and fade in one after another.
notes: the cards are dark by themselves (dark class) on a light section
beam colours: chart-3, chart-2, chart-1 (lilac, blue, green in the prenuvo theme)
